services.name: Cold Plunge
services.desc: The theory behind cold plunge therapy is that exposure to cold water causes the blood vessels to constrict, which can help reduce swelling and inflammation in the body. It can also help improve circulation by forcing the body to work harder to keep warm, which can stimulate blood flow to the muscles and tissues. Cold water immersion has been shown to reduce inflammation and muscle soreness after exercise, helping to speed up recovery. Cold water immersion can help to constrict blood vessels, improving circulation and oxygen delivery to muscles and tissues.
